reading_rules: This is a dated partial evidence index, not a claim that d984 is forever current. Rebind any later main or candidate before using a component proof.
Observed commits, matching digests, model reviews and fixture passes confer no canonical, provider, Finance or consumer authority.
Read each immutable report and its limits before using its scoped result. Source, candidate, local execution, hosted checkout and resulting main identities stay distinct.
Do not sum nested suites, native diagnostics, checks, stages or artifact counts. A required skip remains missing and a historical failure remains a failure.
Local deterministic fixture criteria do not acquire an extra deployment or consumer-ACK gate. Whole-issue and master acceptance require their actual scoped outcomes and accountable review.
Historical provider usage and unobserved measurements remain unknown, never zero. This documentation change performs no provider operation.
New source observations and proof belong in additive dated snapshots. Preserve this snapshot, old manifest observations, failure receipts and original acceptance-null fields.

modes.mock: Synthetic authorities or fixtures; native local clocks, SQLite, child processes or controlled HTTP do not make the end-to-end journey live.
modes.recorded: A retained earlier execution or source observation; its original revision, time and mode remain attached. Reading it is not a new execution.
modes.sandbox: Actual provider or consumer sandbox execution; none is supplied by this index.
modes.live: An actually authorized external execution. The retained public-source attempts remain incomplete or refused and do not establish a live provider/consumer journey.
modes.estimated: An estimate with an explicit basis; no estimated measurement is promoted into actual usage.
modes.pending: Required execution, input or acceptance is absent; no pass, zero usage or authorization is inferred.

evidence_classification.limits: Modes describe evidence, not grants. This index authoring and validation use no paid/provider request. Historical unobserved cost is unknown; that is separate from the absence of new provider calls.
